title: Very good experience
text: First visit to Granada, and after walking its streets, we decided to go into a tablao. Through reviews, we found La Alboreá and decided to book. Our first experience with flamenco. We loved it. A lot of feeling and very good service.
author: mar_acoromo2d

title: Flamenco Show at Alberia.Theatro
text: Quite by chance I found this Flamenco show on line. What a fantastic show worth every euro. Right in the heart of Granada. I’d highly recommend a visit if you’re in the area. We will be back next time we're in Granada!
author: J6566CBpaulc

title: Excellent flamenco show
text: Great flamenco show, very exciting. We sat in the front row, although any seat is good as the venue is small and intimate. All the performers are excellent, the show lasts about an hour and there is no interval. There is a bar to buy drinks before the show.
author: Relax21403116472

title: Excellent Flamnco Dance performance
text: A great show of Flamenco dancing by two very accomplished performers. The show lasted one hour with drinks available in small intermit theatre. There was a performance by a flamenco guitarist and singer and then the flamenco dancing. The dancers were excellent and showed great passion as they told the story related to their dance.
author: homeandawaycp

title: Magic
text: Amazing gipsy night in Granada. Closer place to the city Center. Good voice, music and local dancers
author: Juan_P

title: Great performance
text:
We came to experience flamenco performance, and we are very satisfied! Great guitar, singing and the very best:  the two dancers.
We recommand to visit Sacromonte cave museum in beforehand. Here you will learn som of the background and history of flamenco
author: salve_d

title: A great show
text: To celebrate my Saint, my daughter gave me the surprise and very pleasant to go to see the show on Friday, September 12 at 8.45 pm. I highly value the performance of Manuel Fernandez (with the strength and art that delighted us with the guitar) as well as how the singer is involved, with the dancers, drawing from the music, all the strength that this Art has, both The Isleña, and the companion. All in all, very good level and CONGRATULATE the Group and Enterprise! Thank you!
author: M2371XVmarial

title: Flamenco visit
text: Great dancing and wonderful guitarist. One hour was plenty. Get there a few minutes early to get you a drink before the show starts. Very small right venue but up close and personal to the dancers.
author: khamberis

title: A pure charm!
text: I loved the flamenco! His shows are impressive and he has given me a lot of illusion. I want to recommend these shows for everyone.

title: IMPRESSIVE
text: We went by recommendation of the guide of a free tour in Granada, we had never been on a tablao, the show we loved, the impressive dancers (Andrea Prieto and Paco de Andrea), certainly is a more than recommended activity for anyone visiting Granada
